diagnosis: In this Cloudflare Worker managing multi-tenant rate and usage counters via Durable Objects, the fetch handler generates the Durable Object ID from client-supplied tenantId (env.USAGE_COUNTER.idFromName(tenantId)). It fails to verify that the requesting user is a verified administrator or member of tenantId. Any authenticated user can monitor rival tenants' real-time API call volumes and commercial plan tiers.
